mod.name: Ultra-Wide Menu Alignment
mod.author: Community
mod.description: Centers Inventory, Chests, Personal Chests, Crafting Stations, and Pause Menus into an ultrawide safe zone without affecting your HUD.

settings.label: Enable Ultra-Wide Menu Alignment
settings.description: Master toggle for centering dynamic UI panels.

settings.label: Safe Zone Left Edge (MinX)
settings.description: Left viewport anchor (0.25 = centered 16:9 box on 32:9).

settings.label: Safe Zone Right Edge (MaxX)
settings.description: Right viewport anchor (0.75 = centered 16:9 box on 32:9).

settings.label: Horizontal Fine-Tune Offset (px)
settings.description: Additional pixel translation on top of safe-zone anchors.

settings.label: Center Crafting & Processing Stations
settings.description: Centers Crafting, Smelting, Composter, and Enchanting panels.

settings.label: Enable Debug Hotkeys (Shift + F7/F8/F9)
settings.description: OFF by default. Enable to use Shift+F7 (Snapshot), Shift+F8 (Force Apply), Shift+F9 (Banner), and Shift+NumPad +/- (Nudge).

settings.label: Show Top Inspector Banner
settings.description: Logs active panel status when debug hotkeys are enabled.
